text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: That was great, Taishin! You must be tired.

text_block_list.text:
Not even. Hell, this isn't the time to be
tired.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Her cool demeanor never wavers, but I
can tell
her stride is much more
confident than it was
before the race.
So about my next race...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: You're thinking about the next race already?

text_block_list.text:
You got a problem with that, or are you
looking
to get kicked again?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm still stinging from the one she gave
me before
the race, and I shake my head
hurriedly.

If she were serious, I'm sure she could've
put me in
the hospital, so I assume she
must've been
holding back...

Anyway, about my next race... Or well, I
guess
this is more about my future plans.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I want to take on the Classic Triple
Crown.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna show up all my haters, I
can't do just
any old race.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
My only option is to win the Satsuki Sho,
the
Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka
Sho, where only
the best gather to
battle it out.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'll win 'em and make everyone eat their
words.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
However, the Satsuki Sho is still a ways
off. It
would be best to enter her into
some junior races
so she can gain more
experience.
To that end...
choice_data_list:
How do you feel about running the Hopeful
Stakes first?

text_block_list.text: Isn't that a junior G1 race?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Just like the Satsuki Sho, the Hopeful
Stakes is a
2,000-meter race held at
Nakayama Racecourse.

I tell her that it would be a good
opportunity to
get a feel for what the
real deal will be like.
Got it. Then let's do it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And if I'm running it, then I'm winning it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
With that, we set our sights on the
Hopeful
Stakes!
